name: io.github.airgap-fleet/airgap-file-bridge
title: airgap-file-bridge
description: Local stdio MCP server that lets an AI assistant read and search files inside one folder you choose. Read-only by default; optional editing keeps previous versions. Folder links cannot lead outside the folder. The bridge makes no network connections.

environmentVariables.name: FILE_BRIDGE_ROOT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The one folder the AI may use (absolute path). Required.

environmentVariables.name: FILE_BRIDGE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to let the AI create and edit files. Previous versions are kept in .file-bridge/versions.

environmentVariables.name: FILE_BRIDGE_MAX_FILE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum file size for read/write operations (bytes)
